realZoom.scope: complete visible viewport at real browser zoom 200%; not full page

findings.observation: All six primary controls show a visible disabled checkmark and native tests assert checked, while the live output says 当前选择: off. This is inconsistent Demo feedback, not a missing Checkbox checkmark.
findings.minimumRecommendation: Use one effective checked value for both the public Checkbox checked prop and the live output. Add an output assertion for forced disabled-selected; collect a new candidate after repair.

scopeLimits: Manual review is only Apple and only these 112 original Windows Chromium PNGs; no Firefox/WebKit or Linux pixel comparison was performed.
All repeated hashes were still opened and viewed per case. Image differences or equal hashes do not establish motion or interaction correctness.
Native 337 passed, core 270/270 and environment 60/60 describe automation of the original candidate. The Demo feedback finding remains unresolved in that candidate.
Half-selected states deliberately retain a separate boolean checked value. Their off output is not, by itself, evidence that the mixed indicator is missing.
Density and loading exclusions follow the captured package visual.json. Density controls collection spacing, not standalone control geometry; asynchronous loading belongs to the owning form.
True zoom is chrome.tabs.setZoom 1→2 with CSS viewport 1264→632, html/body zoom both 1; resulting DPR changes are effects of browser zoom, not a DPR substitute. Images show the visible viewport only.
Native boundary case keeps checked and original DOM identity while switching all six configurations; it has no PNG and is not counted as a manually reviewed image.
No video was fully played or reviewed second by second in this task. Reduced-motion PNGs establish static appearance only.
No source, original indices, native report, PNG or baseline was modified. No canonical approval, baseline approval or verified coverage is granted.
The later LineEdit documentation wording repair does not alter this candidate identity. This review remains bound to captured source and artifact fingerprints.
